name: v1.4.5
body:
Sagascript 1.4.5 — Draft release notes

Status: verified, unpublished release draft
Release revision: ebe32eab48791c01afdf5e3b7f77fc7331489c79
Compared with v1.4.4 at 61113e91cd58e09a8d881f473da705dbf4721dd6

Sagascript 1.4.5 is a quality release focused on clearer recovery, safer local
file handling, and more consistent app and CLI behavior.

Highlights

- Recovery flows now use typed error information to show the appropriate
  action: try the operation again or download the required model again.
  Cancellations are reported as cancellations, and focus plus screen-reader
  announcements follow each recovery state.
- Model downloads and installs handle cancellation, verification, filesystem
  syncing, and cleanup more consistently across macOS and Windows.
- The app and CLI share the model catalog and glossary/settings operations, so
  model selection, profiles, and dictionary behavior stay aligned across both
  surfaces.
- CLI JSON and JSONL failures now have stable error codes and non-empty error
  objects, local paths are redacted from engine errors, cancellation has a stable result code, and a closed output pipe ends quietly.
- Meeting reprocessing stages and validates each output before publishing it
  without replacing an existing file. If publishing the proposal fails after
  the cache succeeds, the completed cache is retained and the failure reported.

Maintenance

- Updated Vite to 6.4.4 in the application build tooling to address reported
  vulnerabilities in its bundled editor-launch helper.
- Updated rustls-webpki and webpki-root-certs to address the identified
  RustSec advisories. Native trust behavior still follows the operating system.
- Kept the standalone engine host version aligned with the application release
  and added release version-consistency checks.
- Expanded deterministic app, CLI, engine-host, and Windows release checks.

Availability and verification

- macOS Apple Silicon is the supported stable release target.
- Windows remains an unsigned beta for x64 and ARM64.
- Exact release CI and independent review passed; prebuild 39521450618 passed.
  macOS signing, notarization and packaged transcription/engine-host checks passed.
  Corrected read-only verification 39533272024 passed all 18 checks; the live
  draft asset IDs, sizes and SHA-256 digests were confirmed unchanged afterward.
  The original verifier run 39526373954 failed; its Python pipe reader was
  corrected in PR #491 without changing any release binary.
- Native clean-machine and manual acceptance were not performed for 1.4.5.

This draft makes no claim of improved transcription speed or transcription
quality without dedicated measurements.

Verification: https://github.com/Magnus-Gille/sagascript/actions/runs/39533272024
